title: A Performance Review That Goes Sideways
summaryZh: 績效面談中員工質疑評等的來源，主管坦承回饋延遲，兩人約定定期溝通。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Before we get into the ratings, I want to say that the overall picture here is genuinely positive, so please hear that first.
sentences.zh: 在談評等之前，我想先說整體來看真的是正面的，請你先把這句聽進去。
sentences.note: get into 連讀成 /ˈɡɛ.ɾɪn.tə/，t 變閃音；want to 縮成 /ˈwɑ.nə/。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I appreciate you saying that, though in my experience a sentence that starts with overall is usually doing a lot of quiet work.
sentences.zh: 謝謝你這麼說，不過依我的經驗，以整體來看開頭的句子，通常都在偷偷做很多事。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Fair enough, so let's go straight there: you're rated as developing on collaboration, which is the only area below expectations.
sentences.zh: 說得也對，那我們就直接切入：你在協作這一項被評為發展中，是唯一低於期待的項目。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That's surprising, and I'd like to understand it, because nobody has raised anything with me directly in the last twelve months.
sentences.zh: 這讓我很意外，我想弄清楚原因，因為過去十二個月沒有任何人直接跟我提過。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Some of it came through the calibration session, where a couple of your peers described you as difficult to move once you've formed a view.
sentences.zh: 一部分來自校準會議，有幾位同儕形容你一旦形成看法就很難被說動。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: So the rating rests on an impression formed in a room I wasn't in, by people whose names I'm not going to be told.
sentences.zh: 所以這個評等建立在一個我不在場的房間裡形成的印象上，而且那些人的名字我還不會被告知。
sentences.note: wasn't in 連成 /ˈwʌ.zə.nɪn/；I'm not going to 口語成 I'm not gonna，not 的 t 不釋放。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I understand why that lands badly, and I'm not going to pretend the process is elegant, but it isn't quite as arbitrary as you're making it sound.
sentences.zh: 我理解這聽起來很刺耳，我也不會假裝這個流程有多漂亮，但它沒有你講得那麼武斷。
sentences.note: but 開頭是語調轉折的信號，音高先降再重新起頭；quite as 的 t 在母音間變閃音。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Then help me out here, because I can only fix something if I know which conversations we're actually talking about.
sentences.zh: 那就幫我一下，因為我得知道我們到底在講哪幾次對話，才有辦法修正。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: The database migration is the clearest example, where you were technically right and everybody in that thread still ended up dreading the next email.
sentences.zh: 資料庫遷移那次是最清楚的例子：你在技術上是對的，但那串信裡的每個人還是很怕收到下一封。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I'll take that one, honestly, because I was right and I made absolutely sure that everyone knew it, which was not necessary.
sentences.zh: 老實說那一次我認了，因為我是對的，而且我還特別確保每個人都知道我是對的，那其實沒必要。
sentences.note: right 的 t 完全不釋放，只留一個喉塞音；made absolutely 的 d 連到母音。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That's more self-awareness than I expected in this meeting, and frankly it makes the rating harder to defend rather than easier.
sentences.zh: 這比我預期的自覺多得多，老實說這反而讓這個評等更難辯護，而不是更容易。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I'm not asking you to change it today, but I would like it written down that the feedback reached me nine months late.
sentences.zh: 我不是要你今天就改掉，但我希望白紙黑字寫下來：這個回饋晚了九個月才到我這裡。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That's a reasonable thing to ask, and I'll say plainly in the notes that the delay was mine and not yours.
sentences.zh: 這個要求很合理，我會在紀錄裡明白寫出延遲是我的責任，不是你的。
sentences.note: mine 和 yours 是一組對比重音，兩個字都要拉出來，句子的重點全在這個對比。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Then we're fine, and for what it's worth, I'd rather have this conversation badly than not have it at all.
sentences.zh: 那我們沒問題了，而且說真的，我寧願這場對話談得很糟，也不要根本沒談。
sentences.note: I'd rather 的 d 幾乎消失；badly 和 at all 形成對比重音，句意全靠這組對比。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: So would I, and I'd like us to do a version of it every six weeks so neither of us is surprised again.
sentences.zh: 我也是，我希望我們每六週做一次類似的對談，免得下次又有人被嚇到。

questions.q: Why does A object to the collaboration rating?
options: The feedback came anonymously from a meeting he was not part of
He believes collaboration should not be rated at all
He was never shown his rating before the meeting

questions.q: What does A concede about the database migration?
options: That he was wrong on the technical question
That being right did not excuse how he handled it
That he missed the deadline for the work

questions.q: How does the manager react to A's admission?
options: He says it makes the rating harder to justify
He raises the rating on the spot
He becomes defensive and ends the meeting early
